items.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Brings Over 1 Million Listings To A Major Card Travel Portal
items.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) and American Express have partnered to list over 1 million Airbnb properties on the Amex Travel platform. Eligible U.S. American Express Card Members can now earn Membership Rewards points and receive statement credits on Airbnb bookings made through Amex Travel. The arrangement connects Airbnb hosts with American Express's higher spending travel customers through a new distribution channel inside the issuer's booking portal. items.title: Booking Holdings’ Lowest Recent Target Still Implies 22% Upside. Airbnb’s Growth Tests the Estimates Behind It
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEvery recent price target on Booking Holdings (BKNG:NASDAQ) is above the stock, from Wells Fargo’s $190 to UBS’s $265, even after a 27% drop this year. Wall Street’s estimates already have Airbnb’s (ABNB:NASDAQ) revenue growing faster than Booking’s this year and next, so the bear case that Booking is losing share is mostly priced in.
